style.tail: Bright colorful low-poly 3D clay-like models with soft rounded edges, warm pastel palette of cream, sky blue, mint green and soft coral, on a clean pale cream studio background with a faint soft ground shadow. Soft warm studio lighting from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, no harsh shadows. Clean playful explainer animation look for children, not photorealistic, not cinematic, not dark. No numbers, no lettering, no text, no captions, no watermark, no UI, no logo.
